scientific.integrity: The infinite theorem is proved structurally. Exhaustive finite replay through order 11 for k=1,2,3,4 is used only as a stress test. Literature comparison retains residual risk from older work indexed under uncommon chain/Ferrers terminology.
scientific.limitations: Determines the minimum generalized k-power domination number and extreme singleton witnesses for connected chain graphs; it does not enumerate all minimum sets or propagation radii.

title: Generalized power domination of chain graphs is always one or two
